title: Dark Compute Hub first-run Dashboard
principles: Dashboard remains read-only and links to independent Settings sections
Dark appearance becomes an application-wide theme option
Local, cloud and off modes reflect actual text, image and video routes
Resource monitoring displays only real locally reported metrics
Installed service cards use truthful green, yellow and red status semantics
Active jobs and event history come from real runtime operations
No credentials, endpoint editors or model selectors appear on Dashboard
